visual_review.scope: Manual inspection of the TVB thresholds populated fixture and installed release page on Debian 12, Ubuntu 24.04, Rocky Linux 8 and Rocky Linux 10 (eight screenshots). All 640 screenshots are retained; the other screenshots were not manually reviewed in this batch.
observations: All four populated fixture images show eight entries and seven readable columns, with both temperature/down-bin pairs, complete raw hexadecimal values and row results.
The fixture status identifies logical CPU 130, eight successful reads and a completed scan; the first synthetic row decodes to 70 C, 1 down bin, 100 C and 2 down bins.
The four installed release images show the selected TVB thresholds tab, ready state and empty table before an explicit read. CPU selection, candidate selection, read and copy controls are visible.
Explanatory labels wrap without overlapping the table or status. Native Qt tab scrolling leaves the selected tab visible; earlier tabs are accessible with the tab bar arrows.
Images validate layout and startup only. Fixture values are synthetic and are not evidence of target hardware support or measured TVB activity.
